rules.statement: A lessor is not duty bound to follow the provisions of section 21 of the Finance Leasing Act before issuing a letter of termination if the parties have agreed to the non-applicability of certain sections of the Act, including section 21.
rules.supporting_quote: The above Article of the agreement between the parties clearly establishes the fact that the plaintiff is not duty bound to follow the provisions of section 21 before issuing the letter of termination.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 21 of the Finance Leasing Act No. 56 of 2000
